## Overview

|             |                                                 |
|-------------|-------------------------------------------------|
| **Input**   | `Original Data.xlsx`                            |
| **Output**  | `autism_ipp_recoded.rds`                        |

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Dependencies"}
The parent folder of this document's folder should contain a folder called `Data` with the file `Original Data.xlsx`.
:::

## Set up

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Working directory"}
Quarto runs code from the folder this `.qmd` file is saved in, so you don't need `setwd()`. Relative paths like `../Data/` work as long as the folder layout above is in place.
:::

### Load packages

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
# run once, then leave commented out:
# install.packages(c("tidyverse", "readxl"))  
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

### Load original data

```{r}
#| label: load-data

data <- read_excel("../Data/Original Data.xlsx")
```
